adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/zoho-bigin/lib/CalendarService.ts`, `tokenInfo` is now assigned from `refreshOAuthTokens(...)`. In sync mode (`APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED && CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT && userId`), `refreshOAuthTokens` performs a `fetch(...)` and returns the `Response` object (no `.data`). Immediately after, the code still does `if (!tokenInfo.data.error) { ... }`, which will throw at runtime because `tokenInfo.data` is `undefined` on a `fetch` Response. This is a real defect introduced by the wrapper’s inconsistent return type across paths.
